title: Causal Set Theory
description: Spacetime as a set of events and nothing else but which can affect which. Scatter them at random, and a manifold appears: order plus number gives geometry.

puzzle.goal: Events are scattered at random with density ρ through spacetime. Write the chance P that a region of volume V holds none at all.
puzzle.name: Poisson sprinkling
puzzle.ask: Find P for p = @{p} events per unit volume in a region of V = 3.
puzzle.method: A Poisson process with mean ρV gives n events with probability (ρV)ⁿe^(−ρV)/n!; put n = 0.
